latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of perf-prof skill

- Provides a comprehensive workflow to use perf-prof for Linux system performance diagnosis.
- Details installation, including dependency handling and user confirmation for source builds.
- Includes a full decision tree for selecting the right profiler based on system symptoms (CPU, memory, IO, virtualization, etc.).
- Categorizes and explains available profilers; links to documentation when available, and outlines core analysis techniques.
- Adds step-by-step instructions for both kernel-space and user-space diagnostics.
- Features both Chinese and English descriptions for broader accessibility.
